title: Vendor Contract Beta
summary: Synthetic vendor agreement that intentionally omits indemnification and liability-cap protections.

sections.title: Services
sections.content: Beta Facilities Group will provide office maintenance, badge-printing support, and onsite facilities coordination for Acme Corp's European office locations.

sections.title: Confidentiality
sections.content: Beta Facilities Group must keep Acme Corp confidential information confidential and may use it only to provide services. Confidential information includes office access procedures, employee contact details, and supplier records.

sections.title: Data protection
sections.content: If Beta Facilities Group receives personal data from Acme Corp, it must follow Acme Corp's written instructions and report suspected unauthorized disclosure within 72 hours.

sections.title: Commercial terms
sections.content: Fees are invoiced monthly. The parties agreed to defer negotiation of indemnity language and liability limitations until the next renewal cycle. No indemnification clause, aggregate liability cap, or liability carve-out is included in this agreement.

sections.title: Termination
sections.content: Either party may terminate for material breach after 30 days' written notice and opportunity to cure. Acme Corp may terminate for convenience with 90 days' written notice.

evidence: The commercial terms say indemnity language was deferred.
The contract explicitly says no indemnification clause is included.
The commercial terms say liability limitations were deferred.
The contract explicitly says no aggregate liability cap or liability carve-out is included.
